M. 1</ls>. .²4 Lively, vivid. .{@-णः@} A young man, youth; गतवयसामपि पुंसां येषामर्था भवन्ति ते तरुणाः <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 62</ls>. .²2 The castor-oil plant. .²3 Large cumin-seed (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>जिरें</ns>). .²4 Newly produced liquor; तरुणस्तु नवे यूनि मद्ये प्रथम उत्कटे <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-णी@} .²1 A young or youthful woman; वृद्धस्य तरुणी विषम् <ls>Chāṇ. 78</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of some plants such as Aloe Perfoliata (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कोरफड</ns>), Rosa Glandulifera (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>पांढरा गुलाब</ns>) <ab>etc.</ab> .{@-णम्@} .²1 Cartilage. .²2 A sprout.
